subject: Independent check of FABRIC_BRIDGE_ARCHAEOLOGY
verdict: Sound. Same moral as HIDE: wiring and consolidation, not a new crate pile. Three claims verified directly, one framing corrected.

verified.claim: Docs list gemma2/phi3/mixtral/mamba2 as present; they are extracted off-tree
verified.result: CONFIRMED, and worse than reported. crates/hawking-core/src/model/ contains only arch_config, deepseek_v2, expert_cache, gravity_engine, llama, qwen_dense, qwen_moe, rwkv7, weights. No gemma2, phi3, mixtral or mamba2 module exists -- yet crates/hawking-core/tests/phi3_smoke.rs and gemma2_smoke.rs remain. Orphaned tests for extracted implementations, which is a stronger docs-versus-code contradiction than the report states.

verified.claim: The empty PRODUCTION adapter registry is a deliberate fail-closed gate, not a missing wire
verified.result: CONFIRMED. tools/condense/gravity_execution_adapter.py:5 states the registry is empty so nothing in the repository can execute, and names the evidence required before an entry may be added. Correctly refused as a wiring target -- the same judgement HIDE_KERNEL_TURN required.

verified.claim: No architecture family is honestly PRODUCTION
verified.result: CONSISTENT with the campaign's own sealed receipts. Highs are Qwen dense FULL_PARENT_VALIDATED on small parents and GLM flagship gravity parity at SMALL_REAL_CHECKPOINT; Kimi is reference/synthetic and not serve-registered.

framing_corrected.correction: Six exist across BRANCHES, not within one tree. On the campaign branch only two are present -- hawking-seed-c state::Event and hawking-core StreamEvent. hide-core Event, UiEvent and hide-protocol Items live on the HIDE branch. This is consistent with the report's own finding #1 and does not weaken it; it sharpens what CONSOLIDATE_HAWKING is actually consolidating.
framing_corrected.why_it_matters: The consolidation target is smaller on any single tree than the headline count suggests, but only because the trees have not met yet.

most_actionable_structural_finding.finding: The HIDE crates are not on the campaign branch at all. Every HIDE increment built tonight lives on build/hide-impl-2026-07-19 and its grok/* descendants.
most_actionable_structural_finding.consequence: MCP is REAL_WIRED on the HIDE line and absent on the Continuum line simultaneously. Both statements are true of different trees, which is exactly the condition where a status report lies without anyone lying.
most_actionable_structural_finding.sequencing: The trees must meet before Fabric/Bridge work begins, or the survey has to be pinned to the HIDE branch. This is wire #1 in the report and it is correct.

ordering_advice_adopted: Do not build the Anthropic-compatible surface or /v1/responses until the runtime adapter registry is unified and one durable event authority is chosen. Adding surface area before consolidating authorities is what produced six event models in the first place.
not_evidence_of: runtime behaviour of any Fabric or Bridge path
